source_report.citation_scope: The original authoring cites the generic ACR parameter index. The specific AIUM citation is an independent audit rationale; no direct derivation of the author text is claimed.

sources.title: AIUM Practice Parameter for Diagnostic Ultrasound of the Thyroid and Extracranial Head and Neck
sources.use: Requirement rationale and scope; no copied images, altered report, clinical approval or automatic classification.

conventions.ordinary_anatomy: Image, schematic and model are separate Primer learning obligations, not a claim that the guidance mandates three teaching representations.
conventions.current_observations: Findings, measurements, flow, classification and examination scope need actual patient evidence. They do not create automatic normal-mesh obligations.
conventions.sides: Paired targets follow explicit right/left report choices and the authored bilateral examination. The thyroid isthmus is not duplicated.
conventions.vasculature: Named common-carotid and internal-jugular landmarks are distinct from patency, thrombus and stenosis assessment. No quantitative duplex thresholds or complete duplex protocol are added.
conventions.scope: A focused examination retains acquired and unassessed limits. No unlisted muscle set, sublingual glands, parathyroids, arterial branches or twelve full nodal station volumes are inferred.
conventions.completion: A label, literal binding, license or multiple partial examples never establishes a complete set or clinical approval.

report_guidance_gaps.gap: The report has one lesion-size value. Three-dimensional size, margins and internal flow are not supplied by that value or the static source examples.
A single nodule dimension and a TR choice do not document all three dimensions or every feature required for the selected risk-stratification system.
Level labels do not instantiate each current node, site boundaries or unassessed tissue. Source shape/hilum observations alone are not specific malignant diagnoses.
The form contains no velocity criteria or full dedicated vascular protocol. An ordinary vessel landmark cannot establish patency, thrombus or stenosis severity.

source_contexts.role: Separate tracked ultrasound sweeps with original labels and surfaces; source-label ambiguities remain explicit.
